messages.author: 63023c771a070260
messages.subject: Re: RHadoop reduce job failed
parts:
Hi,
look at this line in the console output
Caused by: java.io.IOException: Cannot run program "Rscript": error=2, No such file or directory

The causes for this can range from not having installed R on one of the nodes to having installed it for one specific user only to the setting of the PATH variable. Also keep in mind that if you log on each node and verify Rscript works, jobs are run under a special account, in a non-interactive context etc. Best is to install R for all users, in the default location. I hope this helps


Antonio
